mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1300 and RSAFS < 700000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising unemployment rate signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE rise > 0.1pp (1mo).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% in the past month indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO decline > 0.5% (1mo).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 1.0% in the past month signals an immediate economic shock, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO decline > 1.0% (1mo).

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) relative to the previous quarter signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 1.0% (qtr).
